clips.title: The story
paras: Greenpaw Village lies between Raynewood Retreat and Silverwind Refuge, where the Foulweald furbolgs remain hostile. Chief Murgut and Shaman Oakpaw lead the corrupted tribe, and Alliance and Horde forces clash with them in Ashenvale.

Greenpaw Village lies south of Raynewood Retreat and northeast of Silverwind Refuge. Since the Third War, the Foulweald furbolgs who live there have fallen to the corruption tainting Ashenvale’s soil and spirits. Chief Murgut leads them, with Shaman Oakpaw as their corrupted spiritual guide. The tribe attacks travelers who enter its forest territory.

The Foulweald’s attacks draw fighting from every side of Greenpaw Village. Alliance sentinels and night elf druids seek to purge the furbolgs to protect nearby outposts and sacred moonwells. Horde forces advancing through Ashenvale also clash with them as both factions press through the woodland.
